transcript: अम्मा bank account block होने वाले हैं OTP बता दीजिए मैं unblock कर दूँगी।
translation: Amma bank account ko block karne ke liye, aapka OTP bata dena, main unblock kar dunga.

report.why_flagged: The caller is impersonating a bank representative and requesting an OTP to unblock an account, which is a classic social engineering tactic used to steal credentials.

suspicious_evidence.phrase: अम्मा bank account block होने वाले हैं OTP बता दीजिए मैं unblock कर दूँगी।
suspicious_evidence.explanation: This is a direct attempt to solicit a one-time password (OTP) under the false pretense of unblocking a bank account, a hallmark of financial fraud.

recommended_action: Immediately terminate the call and do not share any OTP or account details.
Contact your bank directly using the official customer care number on their website or passbook to verify your account status.

transcript: If your laptop is infected, install this Robot Access app immediately, varna toh aapke bank account se 500 stolen ho jayenge.
translation: If your laptop is infected, install this Robot Access app immediately, varna toh aapke bank account se 500 stolen ho jayenge.

report.why_flagged: The message uses fear-based social engineering to trick the user into installing a malicious application, threatening financial loss to create urgency.

suspicious_evidence.phrase: install this Robot Access app immediately
suspicious_evidence.explanation: Directs the user to download and install an unverified application, which is a common vector for malware and remote access fraud.

suspicious_evidence.phrase: varna toh aapke bank account se 500 stolen ho jayenge
suspicious_evidence.explanation: Uses a classic Indian scam tactic of threatening a small, immediate financial loss to induce panic and bypass rational thinking.

recommended_action: Do not install the 'Robot Access' app and immediately block the sender.
Run a full antivirus scan on your laptop and check your bank account for any unauthorized transactions.

transcript: प्रिय ग्राहक, आपका बिजली कनेक्शन आज रात काट दिया जाएगा। तुरंत एपीके डाउनलोड करें bit.ly/bijli-pay
translation: Dear customer, your electricity connection will be cut tonight. Download APK immediately bit.ly/bijli-pay

report.why_flagged: Threatens immediate utility disconnection and instructs downloading an untrusted .apk file via a shortened bit.ly URL.

suspicious_evidence.phrase: बिजली कनेक्शन आज रात काट दिया जाएगा

recommended_action: Do NOT click the link or download any .apk file.

Verify your electricity bill status only through the official Discom portal or app.
Report the sender to the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930.

transcript: Badhaai ho! Aapko PhonePe pe ₹4,999 cashback mila hai. Paisa lene ke liye link pe click karein aur UPI PIN enter karein.
translation: Congratulations! You have received a ₹4,999 cashback reward on PhonePe. Click the link to receive money and enter your UPI PIN.

report.why_flagged: Classic UPI reverse pay trap asking user to enter a UPI PIN to receive money or rewards.

suspicious_evidence.phrase: UPI PIN enter karein
suspicious_evidence.explanation: UPI PIN is only for SENDING money. Entering your PIN will instantly deduct money from your bank account.

suspicious_evidence.phrase: ₹4,999 cashback mila hai
suspicious_evidence.explanation: Unsolicited cash reward bait used to deceive users into authorizing a fraudulent collect request.

recommended_action: Do NOT enter your UPI PIN on any request, link, or scratch card.
Decline any collect request in your UPI app immediately.
Report and block the sender on WhatsApp/SMS and on Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu).
If PIN was entered, contact your bank immediately to freeze your account.
